children: Canada aerospace and defence electronics supplier's Q3 revenue rose 34% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company attributed growth to operational improvements and increased defence program deliveries
Firan Technology did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods
DEFENCE PROGRAMS - Co said ramp-up of deliveries for two large classified defence programs contributed materially to sales and earnings in Q3
OPERATIONAL IMPROVEMENTS - Co said strategic leadership appointments and improved throughput at several sites drove stronger operating performance
PRICING PREMIUMS - Co said many Q3 orders included significant pricing premiums for expedited delivery
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the aerospace & defense peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Firan Technology Group Corp is C$30.00, about 15.4% above its October 6 closing price of C$26.00
The stock recently traded at 30 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 27 three months ago
